title: Simple refund rule
prompt:
Policy: refunds allowed within 14 days. Customer purchased 9 days ago. Return eligible bool. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: eligible. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
